title: Wormhole's Echo: Artifacts & A Hostage Taxi
summary: Deep within the watery vents, a faint radio signal pinged, drawing a mechanic and her knucklehead uncle into a world of strange physics. Interns and maids seemed stunned by the rainbow-colored pipes, marked with markers of debauchery. They passed the ranks of pipes, nearing a wormhole, seeking protection for the nervous nephew. Hopefully, she could invent a solution. In a vast graveyard of failed devices, she worked with limited speed, hoping to establish a new dynasty. A newcomer bothered her, offering fishy lunches from a backroom, a passive-aggressive gesture. Irritated, she examined vampiric artifacts and complex paperwork, a newbie's offer of a spade revealing a sinister proposition tied to a university's border. The demography of the site, and the adjacent viewing platform, hinted at a powerful past. Grounded but resolute, she clutched a keepsake, her fingers still tingling. A flashback to the raid, the manner and majesty of the keeper, and the taxi waiting to usher a hostage, showed how the jinxes had come to ramify.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls

scenes.sentence: Deep within the watery vents, a signal pinged, drawing a mechanic and her knucklehead uncle into a world of strange physics.
scenes.prompt: Wide establishing shot of a dimly lit, watery underground vent system. Rainbow pipes snake through the scene, marked with glowing markers indicating strange physics anomalies. In the foreground, a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, is crouched, pinged by the faint radio signal from a blackberry device. Nearby, interns and maids seem stunned by the debauchery of the flickering lights, while a burly knucklehead named Norman tries to parley protection for his nervous nephew, observing the ranks of pipes before a looming wormhole.
